notes: While '青少年' covers the entire period of adolescence (roughly 12–18), it is often used in formal writing or public policy to refer to 'youth' or 'young people'.
In everyday conversation, you might hear '中学生' (middle/high school student) if you are specifically talking about school-age kids.
